steering layer sweep — preference ΔElo + steered completions
4 emotions · llama: strength s∈{0.1,0.25,0.5,1.0} × Exp2 band-width w∈{2,5,10,20} · gemma: s=0.5

Setup: each emotion steered with its per-layer direction. Exp 1 = steer ONE layer (swept every 5). Exp 2 = steer a rolling, non-overlapping window of w layers. Per config: ΔElo (one-side preference) + steered completions (drag the slider). llama-3.3-70b has a strength slider (top of card) and, for Exp 2, a band-width slider — the full strength×width grid (vLLM-lens; s=0.5 = HF baseline). gemma-4-31b is s=0.5, width 5, and also shows a 1-sentence open "story about a dog" generation. Cards + tables collapsible. Dashed line = canonical layer.
